newsitem.title: ITALY: Preliminary Italy CPI data due May 20, 21.
newsitem.headline: Preliminary Italy CPI data due May 20, 21.

text.p: Preliminary inflation data for May will be released by 11 Italian cities at 1530 GMT on May 20 and 21, national statistics office Istat said in a statement.
Genoa, Trieste, Bologna, Naples and Bari will release their inflation figures on May 20.
Turin, Milan, Venice, Florence, Perugia and Palermo will release their data on May 21.
Inflation in April was 1.7 percent year-on-year. A Reuters poll forecast that May inflation would show a month-on-month rise of 0.2 percent giving an annual rate of 1.5 percent.
The final national inflation figures will be issued on at 0700 GMT on June 4. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
